Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RITES to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RITES Individual Consultant: NX Design Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the RITES Individual Consultant: NX Design Engineer recruitment is 15 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma, Graduation, or Post Graduation in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university. Additionally, a Siemens Xcelerator NX Design Associate Certification is mandatory for this role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Individual Consultant: NX Design Engineer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Individual Consultant: NX Design Engineer position is 62 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided in the current information.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this contractual role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Individual Consultant: NX Design Engineer post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Individual Consultant: NX Design Engineer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Individual Consultant: NX Design Engineer position under this RITES recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the RITES Individual Consultant: NX Design Engineer recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to visit the official RITES website or the provided application link to submit their forms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Individual Consultant: NX Design Engineer role will involve Document Scrutiny followed by an Interview of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for RITES recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this RITES recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this RITES recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the RITES Individual Consultant: NX Design Engineer post is Gurugram, Haryana, with the pincode 122001.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job offered is on a contractual basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the terms and conditions of RITES.
